scope: Continuous five-object physical storage and drawer closure. Development attempts below are not independent statistical success-rate trials.

task_changes.previous: Five separate grasp-and-hold checks, resetting the whole scene between targets; no object placement or drawer closure.
task_changes.current: One persistent world: spoon, pen, bowl, bottle, glass; verified grasp, transfer, release, open-hand withdrawal, then physical handle pushing and home.

nominal_initial_xy_m.meaning: Initialization settings, not measured poses or new classifier features.

configuration_changes.speed_and_force_note: Commands, not constant measured TCP speed or measured finger force. Spoon and pen settle through real gravity; other objects touch the floor before opening.

control_corrections_retained_in_developm: Widened/opened the drawer and adjusted source spacing to provide real hand and forearm clearance.
Selected object-appropriate grasp orientation; bottle grasps in the validated original orientation before wrist rotation.

Full physical detachment is verified after open-hand withdrawal. A floor-support transition is remembered while opening can briefly unload the floor; final support and all other success predicates remain strictly measured.
A 0.10 N opening-force cap was tried in failed development run09 and removed; it is not the accepted controller.
Pre-positioned the arm physically at home before the handle approach to avoid an unreachable IK branch.

Replaced the bowed joint-interpolated handle push with constant-orientation Cartesian IK knots spaced at most 5 mm, checked for at most 1 mm planned midpoint interpolation error. The handle centre is pushed through actual contact.

final_verification_deadline_change.observation: The actual closed state from failed run12 continued for 3.002 simulation seconds with zero failed physics intervals. The earlier 8-second settling deadline was too short; the quiet-hold success criteria were not relaxed.

limits: One nominal configuration, not a success-rate or speed-improvement estimate. Raw failed attempts remain failed. Existing 550-row and 3840-row classifier CSVs are described separately and are unchanged.
